text:
carmen: quick vendor sync re: gaudi gating and h200 BIOS ABI changes. need a short-run runbook for SI + marketplace prep.

leo: flag: vendor mentioned Gaudi perf signoff slipping. any slides or test runs we can reference?

hua_vendor: Gaudi perf team hit a regression on 512 seq mem usage. working fix, but GA may shift by ~2 weeks. H200 BIOS update includes a PCIe firmware bump that requires kernel ABI retest.

nadia: ok timeline impact noted. we need to decouple marketplace copy from GA so we can do a soft listing. can we publish "compatible with" vs "GA"? legal?

hua_vendor: legal prefers "verified on pilot hardware" phrasing until GA. soft listing with pilot language is ok. embargo window still 72h for public announcement.

ravi: runbook items i propose:
- confirm firmware/BIOS SHA + manifest
- rebuild kernel modules against new ABI
- run small-perf sanity (seq 64/256) + long-run (seq 1024)
- capture KV cache behavior under 4 concurrent streams
- validate autoscale triggers in dedicated cluster
- marketplace SKU draft + image tags for pilot

leo: adding infra tasks: reserve lab block for compatibility runs; schedule config drift test; create canary route that falls back to previous model variant if p99 > 200ms.

carmen: can someone post the exact build command for kernel module rebuild?

ravi: sure, using our ci runner:
```
ci-runner --env=lab --target=h200,gaudi --job=kernel-rebuild --config linux/abi-compat.yml --artifacts out/abi-$GIT_SHA.tar.gz
```

nadia: marketing-bot, would a soft listing interfere with marketplace embargo processes?

marketing-bot: Soft listing allowed. Please tag listing with "pilot" attribute and set embargo_date field for GA announcement. Reminder: partner publicity requires 72h partner signoff.

hua_vendor: We'll provide BIOS firmware tag and board manifest by COB Thursday. Also sending a short change log for the PCIe bump.

leo: risk: BIOS patch may change device IDs; module alias mapping must be updated. sam from eng-runtime should be aware. (cc @sam)

ravi: adding test matrix to runbook:
- kernels: 5.15, 6.1, 6.4
- runtimes: cuda-12.3, mi-open-2.1, gaudi-runtime-1.0
- qconfig: fp16, int8, 4bit-adam
- seqs: 64,256,1024
- conc: 1,4,16

carmen: who's on-call for the first 72h of SI? i can doc-runbook but need a primary.

nadia: i'll take communications and marketplace rollback. leo, can you do infra on-call?

leo: yes. i'll set a short-term rotation and post to eng-oncall.

hua_vendor: note: if Gaudi GA slips beyond 2 weeks we'll propose staged access for select SI partners to avoid marketplace delay.

ravi: action items summary: 
- @hua_vendor send firmware + manifest (due Thu COB)
- @ravi publish runbook and CI jobs (due Mon)
- @leo reserve lab + set oncall (due Mon)
- @nadia draft soft-listing marketplace copy with "pilot" language (due Tue)

marketing-bot: Lab block auto-reservation confirmed: rack 3B reserved May 15-21. Auto-notify 72h prior.

carmen: thanks all. i'll drop the doc link in partnerships drive and loop in legal for the soft listing language. Ping here when manifests arrive.

hua_vendor: acknowledged. will send artifacts and timeline ASAP.

leo: small FYI: if kernel ABI check fails we'll need to run a module shim step; cost is ~6 hours for full CI. calling early helps schedule.

nadia: copy. will prep marketplace fallback plan.

carmen: end of thread ".
